issue.title: Stabilize Vim normal-key containment tests under the full parallel lane
issue.description: PROPOSED BY: phase bead sase-n4.1 of epic sase-n4. During required just check verification, the tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py family failed intermittently under the full parallel lane while passing in isolation; the phase diff touched LLM usage-limit configuration and provider hooks, not ACE input handling. Fresh landing audit after just install ran the entire file in a 175-test focused bundle and it passed, confirming the full-lane/pass-isolation shape but not resolving it. Reproduce with just test-contention and durable full-run records, identify whether Textual timing, shared keymap/global state, or test cleanup owns the failure, and make the exact node family deterministic without weakening containment assertions. The historical broad task sase-ct is a retired umbrella that explicitly requires a new node-specific task for recurrences.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired broad ACE TUI full-parallel/pass-isolation umbrella; its close reason requires this node-specific task and forbids +1/reopen.
